create_SaveIntermediate: create a SaveIntermediate layer to capture intermediate values as they pass through a Penzai model
create_SaveIntermediateShape: create a SaveIntermediateShape layer to capture only the shapes of intermediate values in a Penzai model
build_saving_all_intermediates: build a copy of a Penzai model with SaveIntermediate layers inserted at every sublayer boundary
test_saving_all_intermediates_shapes: test saving_all_intermediates with shapes_only=True to capture activation shapes instead of full values
review_saving_all_intermediates_group: review saving_all_intermediates with a custom intermediates_group label for organizing captured state variables
